metadata_evidence.supports: Resistance semantics, source impacts, relative weights and higher scores as greater barriers.
Dams/mining/oil and gas 2023, deforestation 2001-2020, fires 2016-2021, roads 2020.
Terrestrial score construction, inclusion of river/wetland barriers, explicit terra::project("EPSG:5641") and Byte output.
CC-BY-4.0, version 1, published archive/script MD5s matching local files.
Native EPSG:5641 (SIRGAS2000 / Brazil Mercator), original grid geometry, nodata255, Byte values1-34.

decisions: Choose the resistance-analysis copy; the grainscape package contains a byte-identical raster.
Retain native CRS and approximately279.61m cells; the filename does not imply an EPSG:4326 grid or native180m cells.
Preserve source scores unchanged; do not regenerate the ecological model or recompute impact coefficients.
limitations: Paper and script refer to multiple ecosystem resistance layers; only the matched terrestrial layer is admitted here.
Generating-code and publication descriptions differ in the baseline and some historical source-date labels. The supplied raster is preserved, and no silent reconciliation is applied.
